```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 06_probability_catan
title: Choose a settlement
questions:
  - id: catan_corner
    type: figure
    responseFrom: catanBoardIntro.selection
    prompt: >
      Choose a corner to give yourself the best chance of getting resources.
      No need to calculate anything yet, just go with your gut. Click a corner
      to place your settlement; your choice is saved automatically.
    figure: |
      {{< interactive-figure catanBoardIntro makeCatanBoard options='{"mode":"choose","remember":"sfs-catan-choice"}' fallback="A simplified Catan board. Settlements go at the corners where numbered tiles meet; a matching dice total makes a tile produce a resource. Enable JavaScript to choose a corner." >}}

  - id: catan_settlement
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Save response
    prompt: >
      Place your settlement by clicking a spot on the board above, then
      explain your choice here in a few words.
    promptFrom: catanBoardIntro.selectionNumbers
    promptTemplate: >
      You chose the {value} intersection. What made you go for that?
      Explain your reasoning in a few words.
    explanation: >
      Keep your reasoning in mind as we work through the dice example.
      You will be able to compare your initial choice with what the
      probabilities suggest.
```
